name: PuzzlePress — Sudoku Book Interior Generator with Verified Unique Solutions (KDP, Local)
description:
How do I generate a Sudoku book where every puzzle has a verified unique solution — and the solutions section actually matches the puzzles — so I don't earn one-star reviews and a KDP quality flag? Generator tools happily sell you that risk: they generate, they render, they never check.
PuzzlePress generates your Sudoku interior and then proves it: an independent solver pass re-solves every puzzle from its givens alone. Each puzzle must have exactly one solution, and that solution must equal the one printed in the back of your book. Any puzzle that fails is reported, not shipped quietly.
WHAT YOU GET
• A print-ready interior PDF: title page, puzzle pages (1, 2 or 4 per page), solutions section — at 8.5×11in or 8×10in trim, no bleed
• Four difficulty bands by clue count: Easy (40 target), Medium (34), Hard (30), Expert (27) — holes dug symmetrically, uniqueness re-proven after every removal
• puzzles.csv with every puzzle and solution string, plus a generation report with clue-count statistics and the verification verdict
• Deterministic seeds: the same seed regenerates the identical book, so a series stays consistent
• Commercial use: the books you generate are yours to sell
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
In a full-size test run, PuzzlePress generated a complete 100-puzzle Medium book and verified it in seconds: 100 of 100 puzzles re-solved to exactly one solution, clue counts 33–34 (average 33.4), 0 verification problems — a 126-page interior (1 title + 100 puzzle + 25 solution pages) with every page at exactly 8.5×11in, read back and measured after rendering.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no account, no subscription, no per-book fees. Generate one book or a hundred; the tool doesn't care and neither does your wallet.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed.
Scope: difficulty bands are defined by clue count with a uniqueness guarantee; they are not graded by human solving-technique rankings. PuzzlePress generates interiors — covers, listings and KDP account steps stay yours.
